notes.title: Achievements
notes.notes:
Initial batch of achievements has been added (these can't carry over to release, so don't grind).

Minor fixes and tweaks to some things, including a reworked River card.

notes.title: Rally the Troops
notes.notes:
New features & QOL:
* Added premade card rule selections (& custom)
* Added premade board layouts (+ Chess960)
* Improved some visuals around discarding

Gameplay changes:
* Adjusted the number of cards in the virtual deck for each rarity level
* Free piece rarity levels increased
* River card added to extend moats
* Rally Legendary - adjacent pieces will follow the leader if possible [needs quote!]
* Nanopiece crisis starts with a bit more goo

Bug fixes:
* improved tests for check in complex situations
* Full Self Driving pawns will now happily drive you into check instead of exploding
* Regression Queen can now capture
* Pawns now set promotion options early so they can be changed by modifiers

Performance:
* Updated to Godot 4.5 release
* Enabled prebaking of shaders to help first-run performance
* Minor optimizations

notes.title: Update 3139
notes.notes:
Added "Randall's Sliding Puzzle", the first Dangerous card that isn't part of a crisis. This creates a void and gives all players a reusable ability card to slide squares over the void. (see https://xkcd.com/3139/).

(Some minor bugfixes and improvements to internal diagnostics added)

notes.title: Minor Hotfix
notes.notes:
Improved restrictions on Reverse card moves.

Kangaroo can now jump small blockers.

Fix for hotjoin/host changes in games with captured pieces.

notes.title: Hardcore Pawn Update
notes.notes:
Added a bunch of cards aimed to improve the underrated pawn:

* Hardcore Pawn - Boosts health
* Crab People - Sideways movement
* Aussie Pawn - Can kangaroo over pieces in front of it
* Free Your Mind - Teaches a pawn the kung-fu needed to take forwards
* Naruto Run (Legendary Strategy) - They can't stop all of us
* Chessdivers (Legendary Strategem) - Spread some Managed Monarchy

Also some minor bugfixes.

notes.title: End Game Update
notes.notes:
I've been playing too much Stellaris recently. This update comes with end game crises that have a chance to appear and mix things up.

Various updates to the UI / piece destruction / move animations to better support modding.

notes.title: UX Overhaul
notes.notes:
Scrapped the 3D player hand and reworked some shaders for clarity. Added some systems in place to improve what cards can do with physical effects. Allow mods to control collision shape of pieces. More accepting of logic errors in piece modifiers (less softlocks).

Q1000 from the future now is affected by changes to its past self (ie: demotions, damage).

More relaxed view on what counts as checkmate for Get Out Of Checkmate Free.

Sunfish 1.0 is still takes forever to take their turn (but Stockfish can't even cope, so that's 1-0).

Still no background music.

notes.title: Various feedback addressed
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Jadoube Beaucoup can't move through borders or diagonally
[*] Allow wrecking ball to destroy adjacent things on squares
[*] Reverso: Added reverse lock
[*] Portal ring visibility fix
[*] Fixes for piece visibility
[*] Sigma knight modifier can only affect knights
[*] Stricter rules about promotions
[*] Bump rarity for jdoube
[*] BrannigansGambit reveal pieces on move
[*] Adjust HHG damage, remove instakill of piece, add falloff, can't toss over non-jumpable barries, can only play on own pieces
[*] Scanner square distance fix
[*] Draw card at end of turn instead of start
[*] Bear traps can be duped safely
[/list]

notes.title: Unlimited Update
notes.notes:
Well, this is the update that brings the first preview of mod support: https://github.com/markdchurchill/chess-test-mod

Also a bunch of minor changes to card balance and fixes.

notes.title: Stealth Unupdate
notes.notes:
Added some cards for revealing stealth. Added card to promote your Queen to act as your ruler.

Changed the Reverse card to be rarer and less impactful, now restores your piece at the origin of the piece that took it.

Reworked what edges are considered crossed for diagonal moves, this makes walls & portals more powerful and fixes some confusing situations.

Added a 🪲 button to copy game state to the clipboard to share in bug reports.

notes.title: Horsin' Around Minor Update
notes.notes:
Added some horse cards:
[list]
[*] Horse Girl - give your Queen the horse she's always wanted.
[*] Horse Thief - Pawn takes horse from a nearby Knight
[*] Knook Upgrade - directly promote a Rook to a Knook
[*] Sigma Knight - upgrades your Knight to move in a straight line and take no more Ls
[/list]

Fixes for J'Adoube Beaucoup allowing you to adjust pieces onto uninhabitable squares, and for Bear Trap being placed directly under a piece.

Altered explosions to be blocked by walls, damage walls, additional underlying mechanics for future use.

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.notes:
Added a game setting to play with 'open cards' - using this setting the game can be a bit more strategic, as you can see your opponent's hand, and know what they are capable of. It also clears the path for future cards to allow you to spy or fake this information when the setting is off.

Balance changes: Introduced "Demotion" card to counter exploit where pawns that reach the back rank turn into more powerful pieces.

notes.title: Bear Protection Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added modifiers to squares that can adjust piece moves and apply modifiers to pieces
[*] Added Bear Trap card to validate this feature.
[*] Increased the IQ of Sunfish by three points.
[/list]

notes.title: Introducing Sunfish 1.0
notes.notes: Added a framework for AI opponents and basic implementation. This will be added to the modding extensibility points.

notes.title: Improvements to UX
notes.notes:
* Display possible moves when selecting piece
* Highlight past moves and card plays on move list hover
* Better censoring of invisible piece moves

notes.title: Minor Updates
notes.notes:

[*] Cloaking device censors moveset
[*] Increase rarity of "Scandal!"
[*] Hint time remaining on some piece modifiers

[/list]
